statements.statement: The service was for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
The clinical indication note documents intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The symptoms persisted despite initial evaluation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment
The purpose was to further characterize the underlying rhythm disturbance and correlate symptoms with cardiac activity
The denial reason code is CO-197
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R00.2
